[[File:VaderMeditationChamber-SWBTUC.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Darth Vader's hyperbaric [[Darth Vader's meditation chamber/Legends|meditation chamber]]]]
A '''hyperbaric medical chamber''' was a medical device used to facilitate the healing of badly burned tissue. It was a sealed capsule that was super-[[Oxygen/Legends|oxygenated]]. The [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] had a [[Darth Vader's meditation chamber/Legends|personal]] hyperbaric chamber within which he was able to breathe without artificial aids, though only for moments at a time. He had a second such chamber at [[Bast Castle]] on [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]].
